title: Tour AI Studio
blurb: Describe a website, landing page or booking page and AI builds it.

steps.title: Open AI Studio
steps.body: AI Studio builds pages and small sites from a description. Click **AI Studio** in the left menu.

steps.title: Describe what you want
steps.body: Type what to build in the box at the top. Be specific: your trade, your town, what visitors should do, and your colours.

steps.title: Add inspiration
steps.body: You can attach your logo, photos, a screenshot or a web address you like. AI uses them as a guide for the layout.

steps.title: Your projects
steps.body: **My Projects** holds everything you have built. **Recently Viewed** and **Starred** help you get back to the ones you use most.

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.body: Prefer a head start? **Templates** has ready-made starting points.

steps.title: What to do first
steps.body: Next: try **Build a landing page with AI Studio** from the Guide.
